name: ziggy-chaturbate-suite
description: Builds the maintained Tampermonkey userscript and strict-parity Chrome and Firefox/Zen extensions.

scripts.build: npm run build:userscript && node ./tools/build-extensions.mjs all && node ./tools/verify-extension-parity.mjs
scripts.test: node ./tools/validate-userscripts.mjs && node ./tools/test-suite-regressions.mjs && node ./tools/test-github-sync.mjs && node ./tools/test-extension-adapters.mjs && node ./tools/verify-extension-parity.mjs && npm run test:mobile-view
